integrity: The proof reduces the result to exact conditional cycle means under one prescribed permutation-matrix entry. Exhaustive permutation checks and independent array-level covariance checks are supplementary rather than substitutes for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The trace covariance formula assumes the uniform distribution on the symmetric group.
Zero covariance for a selected array does not imply independence.
An equivalent elementary identity may exist in older unindexed random-permutation or representation-theoretic literature.
title: A trace law for cycle-count covariance and exact Cayley–Spearman coupling
